title: Deep Equilibrium Mirror coordinate
hypothesis: A compact coordinate inside a shared contractive equilibrium operator yields multiple stable fixed points with fewer bytes and comparable solver iterations versus direct task forcing and independent storage.
physical_object: one shared two-dimensional contractive linear equilibrium map
mirror_coordinate: task-specific angle selecting a fixed point on an orbit
controls: independent operator and equilibrium per task

development.selection_metric: fixed-point nMSE, solver iterations, actual bytes, stability

fresh.reason: Direct coefficient basis is a matched specificity control.

storage.authority: actual deterministic NPZ inference payload bytes

success_gate: All tasks stable and nMSE <=1e-6; >=20% fewer bytes than independent; iterations within 10% of direct; >=10% fewer bytes than direct coefficient code.
failure_gate: Direct coordinate matches Mirror, any task unstable, or quality fails.
boundaries: no nonlinear DEQ training or implicit gradient claim
